meta.title: Method overload picks first available when calling forward declared function
meta.fix_ref: none named (maintainer: 'This is included in pyright 1.1.251')
meta.build_notes: npm pyright@1.1.250 (2022-05-28) and pyright@1.1.251 (2022-06-01); the reporter pinned the regression to 1.1.243; release window from the maintainer's comment.
meta.notes: Mechanism differs from the screening class (R1 query-order): the order dependence is within one analysis (the lambda's call to the forward-declared second_func is evaluated before second_func's declaration); the false positive appears on a fresh open, as on the reporter's command line. The maintainer could reproduce it only with Python 3.10 defaults (a Python 3.11 beta changed forward-declaration behaviour), hence pythonVersion 3.10.

settings_note: The reporter used the default configuration; pyrightconfig.json only pins pythonVersion 3.10 (see the file note).

files.note: pythonVersion 3.10: the maintainer reproduced the bug only with Python 3.10 defaults (the session interpreter is newer)

repro.steps: Open main.py. Reported: 'Could not bind method "method2" because "Gen[int]" is not assignable to parameter "self"': the overloaded method call picks the first overload because the lambda calls second_func, which is declared later in the file, although reveal_type of the same call shows Gen[list[C]]; declaring second_func first makes the error go away. Probe: no 'Could not bind method' diagnostic may be reported for main.py.
